scope: National lower-house (or unicameral) parliamentary elections, ten Atlas countries, target horizon 2000–latest. Presidential, local, regional and referendum votes are out of scope for the first production pass.

verification_legend.verified_live: Fetched from the named URL during this audit (2026-10-02); the stated format/field was observed in the response.
verification_legend.verified_harmonized: Taken from a harmonized academic dataset (ParlGov development 2023-11-04 / stable 2024 release); must be reconciled with the official source before ingestion.
verification_legend.verified_secondary: Reported by press or encyclopaedic sources; not yet confirmed against the official authority.
verification_legend.background_to_verify: Background knowledge of electoral law/structure; must be confirmed against the cited legal or official source before ingestion.
verification_legend.not_located: Searched for in this audit but not found; absence is not evidence that it does not exist.

field_legend.fields_available: Fields observed in the official machine-readable source (true), absent (false) or not checked (null).
field_legend.national_total: true when the official source publishes a national total row; 'derived' when national totals must be summed from districts (derivation must then be recorded).
